texts.preamble: Naseem Ahmad Azimulla Khan And Anr vs State Of Maharashtra on 12 February, 2026 Gitalaxmi 911-Apl In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction Criminal Application No. 298 Of 2026 1. Naseem Ahmad Azimulla Khan 2. Nafis Ahmad Azimulla Khan ...Applicants Versus The State of Maharashtra ...
texts.facts: 2. By the present Criminal Application, the Applicants are seeking to quash First Information Report bearing Crime No. 78 of 2026 dated 08.02.2026 for the offences punishable under Sections 123 & 223 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 along with Sections 26(2) & 30(2)(a) of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 registered with Shivaji Nagar Police Station, Mumbai.
texts.arguments: 3. Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicants submits that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is pending for consideration before the Hon'ble Supreme Court. He further submits that similar issues are involved in Criminal Writ Gitalaxmi 911-APL-298-2026.doc Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025. He refers to the orders passed in the above said Petitions, wherein this Court has admitted the same and granted interim reliefs. 4. Mr. Sukanta Karmakar, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent does not dispute that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is subject matter of the Naseem Ahmad Azimulla Khan And Anr vs State Of Maharashtra on 12 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151495888/ 1 Petitions, referred by the Applicants in the present Criminal Application. He submits that the present Criminal Application filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short "BNSS") be tagged along with the aforesaid Petitions. 5. Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicants submits that the interim orders granted in the aforesaid Petitions, be also granted in this Criminal Application.

He submits that the present Criminal Application filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short "BNSS") be tagged along with the aforesaid Petitions. 5.
